picks.thesis: Q3 beat (revenue +10% to $1.21B, EPS $4.01 vs $3.40) with full-year revenue and EPS guidance raised ($14.96-15.16 from $14.69-14.94); ~+6% premarket after a -2% market week. Rule 2/3: a 6% gap on a concrete estimate change, held ~20 trading days. Wrong if it closes below Friday's close (the gap fully reverses) or the guidance is walked back.

Q1 FY27 adjusted EPS $0.72 vs $0.51 expected (+41%), sales $3.72B vs $3.64B, and the full-year outlook raised (organic growth 4-5.5% from 3-5%, EPS $3.20-3.45 from $3.10-3.35); +5.2% premarket. Below the 6% bar, so conviction 1 only: the estimate change is unusually large. Wrong if it closes below Friday's close.
